text: {"headline": "Batch K17 review packet: documented records, conflicting accounts, and unresolved audit status", "overview": "This brief summarizes 44 calibrated claims from a review packet about batch K17 measurements, an investor chart, and an investor workbook. Most claims are documented in packet records. Some are reporter statements, and some are allegations about who changed values. Few of the claims are independently corroborated. Several attributions and dates are only partly supported, and the accounts conflict on whether plotted K17 values were fresh runs or copied from batch K12. This brief reports the claims and their sources. It does not resolve the conflicts or assess who did what.", "key_points": ["A document records PERSON_1 requesting the raw instrument files for batch K17 and asking that the original be kept along with its edit history. An unidentified chat participant replied that they would keep it and send it after their shift. The record's date is anchored to 2026-03-09, but its earliest and latest bounds are 2025-03-09 and 2026-03-09, so the date is unresolved. [C001, C002, C021]", "An unidentified participant is recorded as saying they had the earlier copy and that totals did not yet match. [C003]", "PERSON_2 is recorded as saying the matter should be kept in the review queue. [C004]", "An email dated 04 March 2026 with the subject 'Batch K17 measurements and investor chart' is addressed to PERSON_2. The sender states they transcribed an entry for the reconciliation record. The packet records that PERSON_1 recorded six failed tensile runs for batch K17 on 4 March 2026, but the verifier could not establish that this record comes from the email. [C023, C024, C005]", "An allegation attributed to PERSON_1 in an email states that PERSON_2 replaced the six failed runs with copied values from batch K12 in the investor workbook. The packet notes this is uncorroborated. The cited passage states the event as fact without attributing it to an email, and its dates conflict (anchored 2026-03-06; bounded 2026-03-08). [C010]", "The packet says K17 run IDs ending 071 through 076 each carry the instrument's clamp-slip flag and, per the record, should be excluded with a reason rather than replaced silently. [C025]", "Two passages state that the revised workbook has the same six decimal values and ordering as K12, including 42.137 MPa twice. The record also states that an import mistake has not been ruled out, and that the investor chart omits run IDs, which the document says makes reconciliation impossible without the workbook. [C007, C008, C009]", "PERSON_2 presented the revised K17 chart to the review panel in early April 2026. PERSON_2's methods memo states that every plotted K17 value came from a fresh run. This conflicts with the allegation that failed runs were replaced with K12 values. [C011, C015, C010]", "The ledger lists a packet total of 3600.00 USD (status: control, dated 2026-04-10). Its lines list K17 instrument time at 1440.00, replacement clamps at 360.00, and independent repeat runs at 1800.00 (status: reconciliation). [C016, C031, C032, C017]", "After the audit, PERSON_1 put the original machine export in read-only storage, according to a preservation receipt. The receipt states that the audit date remains unconfirmed. [C013, C041]", "The packet states that the audit date is not recorded on the calendar extract and that no signed audit report was available for the packet. [C012, C014]", "The review material requests confirmation of who authorized the disputed change and lists as follow-up identifying the approver, obtaining independent supporting records, and establishing the audit date. No approver is identified in the cited passages. [C034, C037]", "The receipt states the signed audit report and an independent copy of the source register are still requested. It also states it is not a certification of the underlying allegations. [C035, C036]", "The packet states that the authorization and settlement fields are separate and that completion should not be inferred from approval. [C040]", "The packet states that no clinical or product safety claim was tested by the experiment. [C026]", "A reporter states they compared the two exports because the revised chart looked unusually smooth to them. The reporter also reports hearing an unidentified lead describe an unspecified item as a temporary stand-in; the reporter says they were not in the panel meeting and cannot say what caveat was spoken. These statements are unverified. [C018, C043, C044, C020]", "An unattributed note states that no conclusions should be drawn until the source records have been checked. [C022]"], "risk_notes": ["The reporter's account and the email allegation about K12 replacement are unverified and should be treated as allegations, not established facts. [C018, C043, C044, C010]", "Conflicting accounts exist: the K12-replacement allegation versus the methods memo stating every plotted K17 value came from a fresh run. Both are attributed to their sources and neither is independently confirmed. [C010, C015]", "Speaker attribution is incomplete. Several entries are only partially supported because the cited passages lack speaker labels, including the transcribed entry, the attached working register, and the authorization and settlement fields statement. [C028, C029, C030]", "Date conflicts and gaps: some anchored dates have wide earliest bounds (2025 versus 2026), and the audit date is unconfirmed. Timing-based inferences should not be drawn without resolving these. [C001, C041, C012]", "Participants are redacted or unidentified, and some redacted placeholders may refer to different people. The record does not identify them. [C021, C003, C039]", "Corroboration is limited. Most claims rest on a single document, and the packet states that an import mistake has not been ruled out. [C008, C009]"], "limitations": ["The packet does not show who made any change to the investor workbook or chart, or whether any change was made.", "The packet does not establish whether the K12 values are correct, whether they were copied, or whether the revised workbook matches the original instrument output.", "No signed audit report, independent copy of the source register, or confirmed audit date is in the packet. Absence of these records does not show that the underlying matters did not occur.", "The packet does not identify the approver of the disputed change or the unidentified participants.", "The packet does not show intent or the reasons for any action. No conclusion about the accuracy of the reporter's account, or about any person's conduct, is supported by these claims.", "Reporter statements are unverified and lack independent document support. Claims with partial verification may have attribution or date problems that are not resolved here."]}
